# The Grounds by Aldar (full)

> Independent marketing site at thegrounds.ae for The Grounds by Aldar — a vitality-led master community in Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO), developed by Aldar with Dubai Holding. Approximately 1,800 homes: 3–4 bed townhouses, twin villas and villas. Guide starting price AED 2.85M (3-bed townhouse). Expected sales launch December 2026.

## About this site

Static HTML site with local fonts and media (no hotlinked third-party assets). Google Tag Manager container GTM-KSW89QM7. Registration uses a modal form (full name, email, UAE phone +971, broker/buyer role, message); it does not reserve property.

## Payment plan (typical off-plan)

5% on booking, 45% during construction, 50% on handover. Exact schedule confirmed by Aldar at launch.
